sentences.text: Lisinopril tablets USP is used to treat high blood pressure in adults and children 6 years old and older.

quotes.text: 1.1 Hypertension Lisinopril tablet USP is indicated for the treatment of hypertension in adult patients and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older to lower blood pressure.

sentences.text: It also helps reduce signs and symptoms of heart failure.

quotes.text: 1.2 Heart Failure Lisinopril tablet USP is indicated to reduce signs and symptoms of systolic heart failure [see CLINICAL STUDIES ( 14.2 )] .

sentences.text: It can also help lower the risk of death after a heart attack.

quotes.text: 1.3 Reduction of Mortality in Acute Myocardial Infarction Lisinopril tablet USP is indicated for the reduction of mortality in treatment of hemodynamically stable patients within 24 hours of acute myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: Lisinopril stops a chemical called angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) from working.

quotes.text: Lisinopril inhibits angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) in human subjects and animals.

sentences.text: This helps lower blood pressure by reducing the amount of a substance called angiotensin II, which makes blood vessels narrow.

quotes.text: ACE is a peptidyl dipeptidase that catalyzes the conversion of angiotensin I to the vasoconstrictor substance, angiotensin II.

sentences.text: Cough is also a common side effect.
Stop taking lisinopril and call your doctor right away if you have swelling in your face, lips, tongue or throat.

quotes.text: When pregnancy is detected, discontinue lisinopril as soon as possible. ( 5.1 ) Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus. ( 5.1 )

sentences.text: If you have a history of swelling in your face, lips, tongue or throat, lisinopril might make it worse.

quotes.text: Patients with a history of angioedema unrelated to ACE inhibitor therapy may be at increased risk of angioedema while receiving an ACE inhibitor [see CONTRAINDICATIONS ( 4 )].

sentences.text: Tell your doctor right away if you feel dizzy or faint, especially when you first start taking lisinopril.

quotes.text: Symptomatic hypotension is also possible in patients with severe aortic stenosis or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

sentences.text: If you have diabetes and take insulin, lisinopril might make your blood sugar levels go too low. Check them often.

quotes.text: Tell diabetic patients treated with oral antidiabetic agents or insulin starting an ACE inhibitor to monitor for hypoglycaemia closely, especially during the first month of combined use.

sentences.text: In clinical studies, lisinopril helped lower blood pressure in adults and children.

quotes.text: Lisinopril demonstrated superior reductions of systolic and diastolic compared to hydrochlorothiazide in a population that was 75% Caucasian.

sentences.text: It also helped reduce signs and symptoms of heart failure.

quotes.text: In one of the studies, the combination of lisinopril, digitalis and diuretics reduced orthopnea, presence of third heart sound and the number of patients classified as NYHA Class III and IV; and improved exercise tolerance.
